items.source: A new "portable options" design pattern. We wanted to provide as much portability in the ModelCall as possible across different chat based AI Models. There is a common set of generation options and then those that are specific to a model provider. A sort of "duck typing" approach is used. ModelOptions in the model package is a marker interface indicating implementations of this class will provide the options for a model. See ImageOptions, a subinterface that defines portable options across all text→image ImageModel implementations. Then StabilityAiImageOptions and OpenAiImageOptions provide the options specific to each model provider. All options classes are created via a fluent API builder, all can be passed into the portable ImageModel API. These option data types are used in autoconfiguration/configuration properties for the ImageModel implementations.
items.translation: 一种新的“便携式选项”设计模式。我们希望在不同的基于聊天的 AI 模型之间，尽可能提高ModelCall的便携性。存在一组通用的生成选项，以及特定于模型提供商的选项。采用了一种类似“鸭子类型”的方法。ModelOptions（位于 model 包中）是一个标记接口，表明该类的实现将为模型提供选项。参见ImageOptions，这是一个子接口，定义了所有文本→图像ImageModel实现中的便携式选项。然后，StabilityAiImageOptions和OpenAiImageOptions提供了特定于每个模型提供商的选项。所有选项类均通过流式 API 构建器创建，均可传入便携式的ImageModelAPI。这些选项数据类型用于ImageModel实现的自动配置/配置属性。

items.source: The tools(Consumer<ToolSpec>) / defaultTools(Consumer<ToolSpec>) API and the ChatClient.ToolSpec interface have been removed. The tools(Object…​) / defaultTools(Object…​) methods now directly accept ToolCallback, ToolCallbackProvider, @Tool-annotated POJO instances, and collections or arrays of any of these types. Context is set separately via the dedicated toolContext() / defaultToolContext() methods.

items.source: A major change was made that took the 'old' ChatClient and moved the functionality into ChatModel. The 'new' ChatClient now takes an instance of ChatModel. This was done to support a fluent API for creating and executing prompts in a style similar to other client classes in the Spring ecosystem, such as RestClient, WebClient, and JdbcClient. Refer to the [JavaDoc](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/docs/api) for more information on the Fluent API, proper reference documentation is coming shortly.
items.translation: 进行了重大变更，将“旧版”ChatClient 的功能迁移至 ChatModel。新的 ChatClient 现在接收一个 ChatModel 实例。此举旨在支持流式 API，用于创建和执行提示词，其风格与 Spring 生态系统中的其他客户端类（如 RestClient、WebClient 和 JdbcClient）保持一致。有关流式 API 的更多信息，请参阅 [JavaDoc](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/docs/api)；正式的参考文档即将发布。

items.source: The SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY table gains a sequence_id column (BIGINT, or NUMBER(19) on Oracle and INTEGER on SQLite) and a SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_SEQUENCE_ID_IDX index. The timestamp column and its index are unchanged.
items.translation: `SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY` 表新增 `sequence_id` 列（类型为 `BIGINT`，在 Oracle 上为 `NUMBER(19)`，在 SQLite 上为 `INTEGER`）以及 `SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_SEQUENCE_ID_IDX` 索引。`timestamp` 列及其索引保持不变。

items.source: SpringBeanToolCallbackResolver and the pattern of declaring bare Function / Supplier / Consumer beans and referencing them by name via toolNames() have been removed. The toolNames() method has been removed from all chat options classes and from ChatClient.
items.translation: 已移除SpringBeanToolCallbackResolver以及声明裸Function/Supplier/Consumer 圈并经由toolNames()按名称引用的模式。toolNames()方法已从所有聊天选项类及ChatClient中移除。

items.source: Generated schemas now include OpenAPI-style format hints for primitive types (e.g., int32 for int, int64 for long, date-time for LocalDateTime), matching the format conventions used for tool calling.
items.translation: 生成的模式现在为基本类型包含 OpenAPI 风格的 ``format` 提示（例如，``int32` 对应 ``int`，``int64` 对应 ``long`，``date-time` 对应 ``LocalDateTime`），以匹配工具调用所使用的格式约定。

items.source: In the HttpClient-based transport auto-configurations (SseHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration, StreamableHttpHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration), the SDK-level McpSyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer and McpAsyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer beans are no longer applied. Transport-level customization now goes through McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder> and McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder> respectively.
items.translation: 在基于 HttpClient 的传输自动配置（SseHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration、StreamableHttpHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration）中，SDK 级别的 McpSyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer 和 McpAsyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer Bean **不再适用**。传输级别的自定义现在分别通过 McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder> 和 McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder> 进行。

items.source: The internalToolExecutionEnabled option has been removed from ToolCallingChatOptions and all provider-specific ChatOptions classes (e.g. OpenAiChatOptions, AnthropicChatOptions). The corresponding Spring Boot configuration property spring.ai.<provider>.chat.internal-tool-execution-enabled has also been removed.
items.translation: `ToolCallingChatOptions` 类中的所有 provider 特定的 `ChatOptions` 类（例如 `OpenAiChatOptions`、`AnthropicChatOptions`）中的 `internalToolExecutionEnabled` 选项已被移除。相应的 Spring Boot 配置属性 `spring.ai.<provider>.chat.internal-tool-execution-enabled` 也已被移除。

items.source: User-controlled loop via ChatModel directly — simply invoke ChatModel without ToolCallingAdvisor. Tool calls will not be executed automatically; check chatResponse.hasToolCalls() yourself and drive the loop with ToolCallingManager.
items.translation: 通过 ChatModel 直接实现用户控制的循环——只需直接调用 ChatModel，无需使用 ToolCallingAdvisor。工具调用不会自动执行；请自行检查 chatResponse.hasToolCalls()，并使用 ToolCallingManager 驱动循环。

items.source: A new JsonHelper class has been introduced in spring-ai-commons as the canonical way to perform JSON serialization and deserialization. It is instantiable and accepts a custom JsonMapper, making it straightforward to customize JSON behavior per use case. JacksonUtils gains a new getDefaultJsonMapper() static method that returns a shared, pre-configured JsonMapper instance.
items.translation: 在 `spring-ai-commons` 中引入了一个新的 `JsonHelper` 类，作为执行 JSON 序列化和反序列化的标准方式。该类可实例化并支持自定义的 `JsonMapper`，使得针对特定用例定制 JSON 行为变得轻而易举。此外，`JacksonUtils` 新增了一个静态方法 `getDefaultJsonMapper()`，用于返回一个共享且预配置的 `JsonMapper` 实例。

items.source: JsonHelper centralizes JSON operations previously spread across JsonParser, ModelOptionsUtils, and McpJsonParser. The default constructor uses the shared mapper from JacksonUtils.getDefaultJsonMapper(). Inject a custom JsonMapper if you need different serialization settings:

items.source: The individual toolCallbacks() methods on ChatClientRequestSpec and defaultToolCallbacks() on ChatClient.Builder are deprecated in favour of tools(Object…​) / defaultTools(Object…​).
items.translation: `ChatClientRequestSpec` 上的 `toolCallbacks()` 方法和 `ChatClient.Builder` 上的 `defaultToolCallbacks()` 方法已被弃用，建议使用 `tools(Object…)` / `defaultTools(Object…)` 替代。

items.source: When using ChatClient, the .options() / .defaultOptions() methods now accept a ChatOptions.Builder (or any provider-specific builder subtype) rather than a fully built ChatOptions instance. This change is enforced at compile time by the method’s generic type constraint <B extends ChatOptions.Builder<?>>.
items.translation: 在使用ChatClient时，.options() / .defaultOptions() 方法现在接受一个ChatOptions.Builder（或任何特定提供者的构建器子类型），而不是一个完全构建好的ChatOptions实例。 此更改通过方法的泛型类型约束<B extends ChatOptions.Builder<?>>在编译时强制执行。

items.source: The transition should be seamless, and no major breaking changes are expected for existing users of the spring-ai-openai module. All properties (with the spring.ai.openai.* prefix), builders, and options remain fully intact. The existing extraBody configuration parameter transparently maps to the underlying additionalBodyProperties in the openai-java SDK.
items.translation: 过渡应无缝进行，且预计对现有 spring-ai-openai 模块的用户不会引入任何重大破坏性变更。所有属性（带有 spring.ai.openai.* 前缀）、构建器和选项均保持完整无损。现有的 extraBody 配置参数会透明地映射到底层 openai-java SDK 中的 additionalBodyProperties。

items.source: McpSchema.Tool.inputSchema() (and outputSchema()) now returns Map<String, Object> instead of the former JsonSchema record. This allows arbitrary JSON Schema dialect keywords ($ref, unevaluatedProperties, vendor extensions) to round-trip without being trimmed.
items.translation: McpSchema.Tool.inputSchema()（以及outputSchema()）现在返回Map<String, Object>，而非之前的JsonSchema记录。 这使得任意 JSON Schema 方言关键字（如$ref、unevaluatedProperties及供应商扩展）能够完整往返传输，而不会被截断。

items.source: For most applications the change is transparent. The Maven artifact, the spring.ai.anthropic.* configuration, and the AnthropicChatModel / AnthropicChatOptions / ChatClient API are preserved, and code that goes through ChatClient or ChatModel.call(Prompt) does not need updates.
items.translation: 对于大多数应用场景，此变更是透明的。Maven 构件、spring.ai.anthropic.* 配置以及 AnthropicChatModel / AnthropicChatOptions / ChatClient API 均保持不变，因此通过 ChatClient 或 ChatModel.call(Prompt) 执行的代码无需进行任何更新。

items.source: AnthropicCacheType, StreamHelper, and metadata.AnthropicRateLimit were removed; the equivalent SDK types (CacheControlEphemeral, AsyncStreamResponse<RawMessageStreamEvent>, RateLimitException) are used directly.
items.translation: 已移除AnthropicCacheType、StreamHelper和metadata.AnthropicRateLimit；现直接使用等效的 SDK 类型（CacheControlEphemeral、AsyncStreamResponse<RawMessageStreamEvent>、RateLimitException）。

items.source: In WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider, WebMvcStatelessServerTransport, and WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider, the Map<String, List<String>> passed to securityValidator.validateHeaders(headers) now has all header names normalized to lowercase.
items.translation: 在WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider、WebMvcStatelessServerTransport和WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider中，传递给securityValidator.validateHeaders(headers)的Map<String, List<String>>现在会将所有头名称规范化为小写。

items.source: The type of the portable chat options (frequencyPenalty, presencePenalty, temperature, topP) has been changed from Float to Double.
items.translation: 便携式聊天选项的类型（frequencyPenalty、presencePenalty、temperature、topP）已从 Float 更改为 Double。

items.source: A Spring Boot auto-configuration (spring-ai-autoconfigure-tool-search-advisor) and matching starter (spring-ai-starter-tool-search-advisor) are now available. When enabled, ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor replaces the default ToolCallingAdvisor in the auto-configured ChatClient, limiting the tool definitions sent to the LLM per call to only the most relevant ones (via keyword or semantic search).
items.translation: 现已提供 Spring Boot 自动配置（spring-ai-autoconfigure-tool-search-advisor）及对应的启动器（spring-ai-starter-tool-search-advisor）。启用后，ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor 将替换自动配置的 ChatClient 中的默认 ToolCallingAdvisor，从而限制每次调用发送给 LLM 的工具定义数量，仅包含最相关的工具（通过关键词或语义搜索筛选）。

items.source: ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate (previously deprecated since 2.0.0) and its default implementation DefaultToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate have been removed. These interfaces combined an options-based policy check (internalToolExecutionEnabled) with a response check (hasToolCalls()). Since the options-based flag is gone, there is no replacement at the ChatModel level.
items.translation: ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate（自 2.0.0 版本起已弃用）及其默认实现 DefaultToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate 已被移除。这些接口结合了基于选项的策略检查（internalToolExecutionEnabled）与响应检查（hasToolCalls()）。由于基于选项的标志已不再存在，因此在 ChatModel 级别没有相应的替代方案。

items.source: A new spring.ai.chat.client.tool-calling.enabled property (default true) controls whether the ToolCallingAdvisor is auto-registered by the auto-configured ChatClient. Set it to false to disable automatic tool execution for all calls — tools are still sent to the AI model as definitions, but tool call responses are not executed automatically.
items.translation: 新增的 `spring.ai.chat.client.tool-calling.enabled` 属性（默认值为 `true`）用于控制是否由自动配置的 `ChatClient` 自动注册 `ToolCallingAdvisor`。将其设置为 `false` 可禁用所有调用的自动工具执行——工具仍作为定义发送给 AI 模型，但不会自动执行工具调用响应。

items.source: Options classes (like ChatOptions, EmbeddingOptions, etc.) are now strictly immutable. Collections within options (like toolCallbacks, stopSequences, customHeaders) are now stored as unmodifiable collections. Additionally, nullable collections are now used instead of empty ones to better represent the absence of a value.
items.translation: Options 类（如ChatOptions、EmbeddingOptions等）现已严格不可变。 Options 中的集合（如toolCallbacks、stopSequences、customHeaders）现在以不可修改的集合形式存储。 此外，现使用可空集合而非空集合，以更准确地表示值的缺失。

items.source: The elicit(…​) overloads that previously accepted tools.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T> in McpAsyncRequestContext and McpSyncRequestContext now accept org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference<T>.
items.translation: 之前接受 `tools.jackson.core.type.TypeReference` 的 `elicit(…​)` 重载方法，现在在 `McpAsyncRequestContext` 和 `McpSyncRequestContext` 中已改为接受 `org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference`。

items.source: A ToolAdvisor marker interface has been added. ToolCallingAdvisor implements it. DefaultChatClient checks for this marker to decide whether to auto-register a ToolCallingAdvisor — if any advisor in the chain already implements ToolAdvisor, auto-registration is skipped.
items.translation: 已添加一个名为 `ToolAdvisor` 的标记接口。`ToolCallingAdvisor` 实现了该接口。`DefaultChatClient` 会检查此标记，以决定是否自动注册一个 `ToolCallingAdvisor`——如果链中的任何 advisor 已经实现了 `ToolAdvisor`，则跳过自动注册。

items.source: The conversation ID is no longer optional for the built-in memory advisors (MessageChatMemoryAdvisor and VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor). Every call through these advisors must supply ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID via the advisor context. If the value is absent or null, the advisor throws an IllegalArgumentException immediately.
items.translation: 内置记忆顾问（MessageChatMemoryAdvisor 和 VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor）的对话 ID 不再可选。 通过这些顾问进行的每次调用都必须通过顾问上下文提供 ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID。 如果该值缺失或为 null，顾问将立即抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

items.translation: org.springframework.ai.anthropic.api.AnthropicApi 及其所有嵌套记录类型（ChatCompletionRequest、ContentBlock、Tool、ToolChoice*以及流式事件记录）已移除。引用这些内容的代码将无法编译。

items.translation: 更新导入：将所有从 org.springframework.ai.openai.audio.speech. 的导入替换为 org.springframework.ai.audio.tts.

items.source: The constant CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_KEY has been renamed to CONVERSATION_ID and moved from AbstractChatMemoryAdvisor to the ChatMemory interface. Update your imports to use org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID.
items.translation: 常量CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_KEY已重命名为CONVERSATION_ID，并从AbstractChatMemoryAdvisor移至ChatMemory接口。请更新您的导入语句以使用org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID。

items.source: Content, MediaContent, and Media have moved from org.springframework.ai.model to org.springframework.ai.content.
items.translation: Content、MediaContent 和 Media 已从 org.springframework.ai.model 移至 org.springframework.ai.content。

items.source: Provides AI capability abstractions: - Interfaces like ChatModel, EmbeddingModel, and ImageModel - Message types and prompt templates - Function-calling framework (ToolDefinition, ToolCallback) - Content filtering and observation support
items.translation: 提供 AI 能力抽象： - 接口如ChatModel、EmbeddingModel和ImageModel - 消息类型和提示模板 - 函数调用框架（ToolDefinition、ToolCallback） - 内容过滤和观察支持

items.source: any tool passed via the functions() method or the functionCallbacks() of the default FunctionCallingOptions instance is now handled in the same way: it is included in each call to the model from that ChatModel instance, possibly overwritten by runtime options. With that, there is consistency in the way tools are included in calls to the model and prevents any confusion due to a difference in behavior between functionCallbacks() and all the other options.
items.translation: 通过 `functions()` 方法或默认 `FunctionCallingOptions` 实例的 `functionCallbacks()` 传递的任何工具现在都以相同的方式处理：它们会被包含在该 `ChatModel` 实例对模型的每次调用中，并可能由运行时选项覆盖。这样一来，工具被包含在模型调用中的方式保持一致，避免了因 `functionCallbacks()` 与其他所有选项的行为差异而导致的任何混淆。

items.source: If you are upgrading to Spring Boot 3.4.2, please make sure to refer to this documentation for the changes required to configure the REST Client. Notably, if you don’t have an HTTP client library on the classpath, this will likely result in the use of JdkClientHttpRequestFactory where SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory would have been used previously. To switch to use SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory, you need to set spring.http.client.factory=simple.
items.translation: 如果您正在升级到 Spring Boot 3.4.2，请务必参考此文档以了解配置 REST Client 所需的变更。值得注意的是，如果您的类路径中没有 HTTP 客户端库，这可能会导致使用JdkClientHttpRequestFactory，而此前使用的是SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory。若要切换为使用SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory，您需要设置spring.http.client.factory=simple。

items.source: We renamed the 'old' ModelClient to Model and renamed implementing classes, for example ImageClient was renamed to ImageModel. The Model implementation represents the portability layer that converts between the Spring AI API and the underlying AI Model API.
items.translation: 我们将“旧版”ModelClient重命名为Model，并相应重命名了实现类，例如将ImageClient重命名为ImageModel。Model的实现代表了可移植性层，负责在 Spring AI API 与底层 AI Model API 之间进行转换。

items.source: If you need memory inside the loop (e.g. with InMemoryChatMemoryRepository), explicitly set the advisor order above ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER and call .disableInternalConversationHistory():
items.translation: 如果您需要在循环内部使用内存（例如配合InMemoryChatMemoryRepository），请明确将顾问顺序设置为高于ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER，并调用.disableInternalConversationHistory()：

items.source: ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker (Function<ChatResponse, Boolean>) can now be set on ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder to customize when the tool-call loop iterates. The default is chatResponse → chatResponse != null && chatResponse.hasToolCalls().
items.translation: ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker（类型为Function<ChatResponse, Boolean>）现在可以设置于ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder，以自定义工具调用循环的迭代时机。默认值为chatResponse → chatResponse != null && chatResponse.hasToolCalls()。

items.source: The streamToolCallResponses option has been removed from ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder, ToolCallAdvisor.Builder, and ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor.Builder, as well as from their corresponding Spring Boot auto-configuration properties:
items.translation: `streamToolCallResponses` 选项已从 `ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder`、`ToolCallAdvisor.Builder` 和 `ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor.Builder` 中移除，同时也从其对应的 Spring Boot 自动配置属性中移除：

items.source: The JdbcChatMemoryRepository schema adds a sequence_id BIGINT column that determines message ordering within a conversation. Previously, ordering relied on the timestamp column, but TIMESTAMP precision differs across databases — on MySQL and MariaDB the default precision is one second, so messages saved within the same second were returned in a non-deterministic order. A dedicated integer sequence orders identically across every supported database.
items.translation: JdbcChatMemoryRepository 架构新增了一个 sequence_id BIGINT 列，用于确定对话中消息的排序。此前，排序依赖于 timestamp 列，但由于不同数据库的 TIMESTAMP 精度存在差异——在 MySQL 和 MariaDB 中默认精度为秒级，因此同一秒内保存的消息会以非确定性顺序返回。专用的整数序列在所有支持的数据库中均保持一致的排序。

items.source: Building on the chat configuration changes described above, the configuration properties for all other models (Embedding, Image, Audio, Moderation, OCR, etc.) no longer use the .options prefix. For example, the former spring.ai.openai.embedding.options.model is now spring.ai.openai.embedding.model. Deprecated configuration properties are provided for the .options variants to ensure a smoother migration experience.
items.translation: 基于上述聊天配置变更，其他所有模型（包括嵌入、图像、音频、内容审核、OCR 等）的配置属性不再使用 `.options` 前缀。 例如，之前的 `spring.ai.openai.embedding.options.model` 现在已改为 `spring.ai.openai.embedding.model`。 为确保迁移过程更加顺畅，系统仍提供针对 `.options` 变体的废弃配置属性。

If you need a custom configuration, either supply a pre-configured ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder at ChatClient construction time (see the Customizing the Default ToolCallingAdvisor section), or disable auto-registration and register the advisor manually:
items.translation: 从链中移除显式的ToolCallingAdvisor，并让自动注册机制来处理它。如果您需要自定义配置，可以在构建ChatClient时提供一个预配置的ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder（请参阅自定义默认 ToolCallingAdvisor部分），或者禁用自动注册并手动注册该顾问：

items.translation: spring-ai-azure-openai 模块（及其相关的 Spring Boot Starter spring-ai-starter-model-azure-openai 和自动配置类 spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-azure-openai）已从 Spring AI 中移除。

items.translation: spring-ai-openai-sdk 模块（及其相关的 Spring Boot Starter spring-ai-starter-model-openai-sdk 和自动配置类 spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-openai-sdk）已从 Spring AI 中移除。

items.source: When constructing tools via McpSchema.Tool.Builder, the deprecated inputSchema(JsonSchema) helper is still available for backwards compatibility, but prefer inputSchema(Map) or inputSchema(McpJsonMapper, String).
items.translation: 通过 McpSchema.Tool.Builder 构建工具时，为了向后兼容，已过时的 inputSchema(JsonSchema) 辅助方法仍然可用，但建议使用 inputSchema(Map) 或 inputSchema(McpJsonMapper, String)。

items.source: The org.springframework.ai.chat.metadata.Usage interface gains two default methods, getCacheReadInputTokens() and getCacheWriteInputTokens(). Both return null when the provider doesn’t report a value.
items.translation: `org.springframework.ai.chat.metadata.Usage` 接口新增了两个默认方法：`getCacheReadInputTokens()` 和 `getCacheWriteInputTokens()`。当提供者未报告相应值时，这两个方法均返回 `null`。

items.source: spring-ai-anthropic is now built on com.anthropic:anthropic-java instead of the hand-rolled RestClient / WebClient implementation.
items.translation: spring-ai-anthropic 现已基于 com.anthropic:anthropic-java 构建，而非之前手工实现的 RestClient / WebClient。

items.source: Code that imported from org.springframework.ai.anthropic.api, constructed AnthropicChatModel with an AnthropicApi argument, or depended on the old maxTokens default does need attention.
items.translation: 从org.springframework.ai.anthropic.api导入的代码、使用AnthropicApi参数构建AnthropicChatModel的代码，或依赖于旧的maxTokens默认值的代码都需要关注。

items.source: Display.SUMMARIZED and Display.OMITTED on the thinkingEnabled / thinkingAdaptive builders, so Claude can use a thinking budget without surfacing the full reasoning.
items.translation: 在 `thinkingEnabled` 和 `thinkingAdaptive` 构建器中设置 `Display.SUMMARIZED` 和 `Display.OMITTED`，使 Claude 能够在不展示完整推理过程的情况下使用思考预算。

items.source: Rewrites all import statements across .java files to point to the new org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.* packages.
items.translation: 将所有 `.java` 文件中的 `import` 语句重写，使其指向新的 `org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.*` 包。

items.source: Previously, header names were passed with their original HTTP case (e.g. "Authorization", "Content-Type"). They are now always lowercase (e.g. "authorization", "content-type").
items.translation: 以前，请求头名称会以其原始的 HTTP 大小写形式传递（例如 `"Authorization"`、`"Content-Type"`）。现在，它们始终为小写形式（例如 `"authorization"`、`"content-type"`）。

items.source: Conversation history is no longer automatically added to ToolContext. The TOOL_CALL_HISTORY constant and getToolCallHistory() method have been removed from the ToolContext class.
items.translation: 对话历史不再自动添加到ToolContext中。ToolContext类中的TOOL_CALL_HISTORY常量和getToolCallHistory()方法已被移除。

items.source: MessageAggregator class has been moved from org.springframework.ai.chat.model package in the spring-ai-client-chat module to the spring-ai-model module (same package name)
items.translation: `MessageAggregator` 类已从 `spring-ai-client-chat` 模块中的 `org.springframework.ai.chat.model` 包移至 `spring-ai-model` 模块（包名相同）。

items.source: The aggregateChatClientResponse method has been removed from MessageAggregator and moved to a new class ChatClientMessageAggregator in the org.springframework.ai.chat.client package
items.translation: `MessageAggregator` 类中的 `aggregateChatClientResponse` 方法已被移除，并移至 `org.springframework.ai.chat.client` 包中的新类 `ChatClientMessageAggregator`。

items.source: KeywordMetadataEnricher and SummaryMetadataEnricher have moved from org.springframework.ai.transformer to org.springframework.ai.chat.transformer.
items.translation: KeywordMetadataEnricher 和 SummaryMetadataEnricher 已从 org.springframework.ai.transformer 移至 org.springframework.ai.chat.transformer。

items.source: Additionally, the ToolContext class has now been marked as final and cannot be extended anymore. It was never supposed to be subclassed. You can add all the contextual data you need when instantiating a ToolContext, in the form of a Map<String, Object>. For more information, check the [documentation](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/api/tools.html#_tool_context).
items.translation: 此外，`ToolContext` 类现已标记为 final，不再允许进行扩展。该类本就不应被继承。在实例化 `ToolContext` 时，您可以以 `Map<String, Object>` 的形式添加所有所需的上下文数据。有关更多信息，请查看 [文档](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/api/tools.html#_tool_context)。

items.source: In Azure OpenAI, the type of the chat options frequencyPenalty and presencePenalty has been changed from Double to Float, consistently with all the other implementations.
items.translation: 在 Azure OpenAI 中，聊天选项 `frequencyPenalty` 和 `presencePenalty` 的类型已从 `Double` 更改为 `Float`，以与其他所有实现保持一致。

items.source: Former spring-ai-vertex-ai has been renamed to spring-ai-vertex-ai-palm2 and spring-ai-vertex-ai-spring-boot-starter has been renamed to spring-ai-vertex-ai-palm2-spring-boot-starter.
items.translation: 原 `spring-ai-vertex-ai` 已重命名为 `spring-ai-vertex-ai-palm2`，而 `spring-ai-vertex-ai-spring-boot-starter` 已重命名为 `spring-ai-vertex-ai-palm2-spring-boot-starter`。

items.source: Moving the prompt and messages and metadata packages to subpackages of org.springframework.ai.chat
items.translation: 将 `prompt`、`messages` 和 `metadata` 包移至 `org.springframework.ai.chat` 的子包中。

items.source: Artifact: spring-ai-tool-search-advisor (previously bundled in spring-ai-tool-search-tool)
items.translation: 构件：spring-ai-tool-search-advisor（此前包含在spring-ai-tool-search-tool中）

items.source: Code that sets .internalToolExecutionEnabled(false) to opt into user-controlled tool execution will no longer compile. Code that sets .internalToolExecutionEnabled(true) (explicitly enabling the internal loop) will no longer compile, and the behaviour it implied no longer exists — per-model internal tool execution has been removed from all ChatModel implementations.
items.translation: 将 `.internalToolExecutionEnabled(false)` 设置为以启用用户控制的工具执行，该代码将不再编译。 将 `.internalToolExecutionEnabled(true)`（显式启用内部循环）的代码也将不再编译，且其原本隐含的行为已不复存在——所有 `ChatModel` 实现中均已移除了每模型内部工具执行功能。

items.source: ToolCallingAdvisor via ChatClient (recommended) — auto-registered when tools are present; no flag needed.
items.translation: ToolCallingAdvisor 通过 ChatClient（推荐）——当存在工具时自动注册；无需设置标志。

items.source: If you implemented ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate to customize when tool execution fires, migrate to ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker (see below) and supply it to ToolCallingAdvisor.
items.translation: 如果您实现了ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate来自定义工具执行的触发时机，请迁移至使用ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker（见下文），并将其提供给ToolCallingAdvisor。

items.source: When streamToolCallResponses=true, intermediate tool-call request chunks were streamed downstream but the paired ToolResponseMessage (sent back to the LLM) was not. Any downstream memory advisor that recorded those chunks would receive a tool-call request without the corresponding tool response, producing a corrupted conversation history. The design flaw cannot be fixed without introducing a breaking change to ChatClientResponse, so the option has been removed entirely.
items.translation: 当 `streamToolCallResponses=true` 时，中间的工具调用请求片段会被流式传输到下游，但配对的 `ToolResponseMessage`（发送回 LLM 的消息）则不会。任何记录这些片段的下游内存顾问都会收到缺少相应工具响应的工具调用请求，从而导致对话历史损坏。由于修复此设计缺陷需要对 `ChatClientResponse` 引入破坏性变更，因此该选项已被完全移除。

items.source: The timestamp column is retained. It now stores the message creation time and is exposed in the message metadata under the JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS key (a java.time.Instant), so applications can display when a message was created. The timestamp is preserved across saves: re-saving a conversation keeps each existing message’s original creation time.
items.translation: 保留 `timestamp` 列。该列现在存储消息的创建时间，并通过键 `JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS`（类型为 `java.time.Instant`）在消息元数据中暴露，以便应用程序能够显示消息的创建时间。该时间戳在保存过程中得以保留：重新保存对话会保持每条现有消息的原始创建时间不变。

items.source: Adapt the identifier quoting and the row-identity expression (ctid above) to your database. The ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY <timestamp>) pattern reproduces the existing per-conversation order on every supported engine. Alternatively, since chat memory holds recent conversation context rather than permanent history, you can drop and recreate the table from the updated schema-<platform>.sql script.
items.translation: 根据您的数据库调整标识符引号和行身份表达式（即上文中的ctid）。ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY <timestamp>) 模式可在所有支持的引擎上重现现有的每会话顺序。或者，由于聊天记忆存储的是最近的对话上下文而非永久历史记录，您可以从更新的 schema-<platform>.sql 脚本中删除并重建该表。

items.source: To create a modified copy of an options instance, use the mutate() method instead of copy() or fromOptions():
items.translation: 要创建选项实例的修改副本，请使用 mutate() 方法，而不是 copy() 或 fromOptions()：

items.source: Default values for options (like default model names, temperatures, etc.) have been moved from the Model implementations and *Properties configuration classes to the options constructors themselves. Default configuration properties in *Properties classes have been removed as they are no longer needed and should be consistent with the options-level defaults.
items.translation: 选项的默认值（例如默认模型名称、温度等）已从 `Model` 实现类和 `*Properties` 配置类中移至选项构造函数本身。 `*Properties` 类中的默认配置属性已被移除，因为它们不再需要，且应与选项级别的默认值保持一致。

items.source: The toOptions() method has been moved from the nested Options class to the root *Properties class.
items.translation: `toOptions()` 方法已从嵌套的 `Options` 类移至根 `*Properties` 类。

items.source: Update your application.properties or application.yml to remove the .options segment from the property keys.
items.translation: 更新您的 `application.properties` 或 `application.yml`，从属性键中移除 `.options` 部分。

items.source: The N() builder method in various *Options and configuration properties classes has been renamed to n() to align with Java naming conventions.
items.translation: 各种 `*Options` 和配置属性类中的 `N()` 构建器方法已重命名为 `n()`，以符合 Java 命名约定。

items.source: JsonParser (in org.springframework.ai.util.json) is deprecated for removal. All methods now delegate to JsonHelper.
items.translation: JsonParser（位于 org.springframework.ai.util.json）已标记为即将移除的弃用状态。所有方法现已委托给 JsonHelper。

items.source: McpJsonParser (in org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.method.tool.utils) has been deleted. Its functionality is now covered by JsonHelper.
items.translation: McpJsonParser（位于org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.method.tool.utils）已被删除。其功能现由JsonHelper 覆盖。

items.source: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails has been moved from org.springframework.ai.google.genai to org.springframework.ai.google.genai.embedding.
items.translation: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails 已从 org.springframework.ai.google.genai 移至 org.springframework.ai.google.genai.embedding。

items.source: A MemoryAdvisor marker interface has been added. BaseChatMemoryAdvisor now extends it. DefaultChatClient uses this marker to detect downstream memory advisors and disable the `ToolCallingAdvisor’s internal conversation history when one is present.
items.translation: 已添加 `MemoryAdvisor` 标记接口。BaseChatMemoryAdvisor 现已继承该接口。DefaultChatClient 利用此标记来检测下游内存顾问，并在存在此类顾问时禁用 `ToolCallingAdvisor` 的内部对话历史。

items.source: A new 5-argument ChatClient.builder() static method and a matching DefaultChatClientBuilder constructor accept a ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder<?> to configure the advisor used during auto-registration:
items.translation: 新增了一个接受 `ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder<?>` 参数的五参数静态方法 `ChatClient.builder()`，以及与之匹配的 `DefaultChatClientBuilder` 构造函数，用于配置在自动注册期间使用的顾问：

items.source: MethodToolCallbackProvider now throws IllegalArgumentException (instead of IllegalStateException) in two cases:
items.translation: MethodToolCallbackProvider 现在在两种情况下抛出 IllegalArgumentException（而非 IllegalStateException）：

items.source: Code that catches IllegalStateException from MethodToolCallbackProvider (directly or via ToolCallbacks.from()) must be updated.
items.translation: 捕获来自MethodToolCallbackProvider（直接或通过ToolCallbacks.from()）的IllegalStateException的代码必须更新。

items.source: Properties annotated with @JsonProperty(required = false), including @JsonProperty declarations where required is not specified, are no longer treated as required.
items.translation: 使用 @JsonProperty(required = false) 注解的属性，包括未指定 required 的 @JsonProperty 声明，不再被视为必需。

items.source: the metric/span attribute gen_ai.operation.name has value execute_tool instead of framework.
items.translation: 指标/跨度属性 `gen_ai.operation.name` 的值为 `execute_tool`，而非 `framework`。

items.source: The constant ChatMemory.DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ID (value "default") has been removed from the ChatMemory interface.
items.translation: ChatMemory 接口中已移除常量 ChatMemory.DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ID（值为 "default"）。

items.source: The .conversationId(String) builder method has been removed from MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder and VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder. Setting a default conversation ID at construction time is no longer supported.
items.translation: `MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder` 和 `VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder` 中的 `.conversationId(String)` 构建器方法已被移除。 在构造时设置默认对话 ID 的功能不再支持。

items.source: Replace PromptChatMemoryAdvisor with MessageChatMemoryAdvisor. The builder API is identical. Instead of injecting memory as plain text into the system prompt, MessageChatMemoryAdvisor includes the conversation history directly as chat messages in the prompt.
items.translation: 将 `PromptChatMemoryAdvisor` 替换为 `MessageChatMemoryAdvisor`。构建器 API 完全相同。 `MessageChatMemoryAdvisor` 不再将记忆作为纯文本注入系统提示，而是直接将对话历史作为聊天消息包含在提示中。

items.source: The deprecated Builder.customizeRequest() method has been removed from HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder and HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder.
items.translation: 已弃用的 `Builder.customizeRequest()` 方法已从 `HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder` 和 `HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder` 中移除。

items.source: AnthropicChatOptions#maxTokens defaults to 4096 instead of 500. Responses that hit the old cap will now run longer, with correspondingly higher token usage.
items.translation: AnthropicChatOptions#maxTokens 的默认值从 500 改为 4096。此前达到旧上限的响应现在将持续更长时间，相应的令牌使用量也会更高。

items.source: AnthropicServiceTier.AUTO / STANDARD_ONLY for Anthropic’s priority capacity tier. Property spring.ai.anthropic.chat.service-tier.
items.translation: AnthropicServiceTier.AUTO 或 STANDARD_ONLY，用于设置 Anthropic 的优先级容量层级。属性为 spring.ai.anthropic.chat.service-tier。

items.source: inferenceGeo("us") or inferenceGeo("eu") for data-residency routing. Property spring.ai.anthropic.chat.inference-geo.
items.translation: 使用 `inferenceGeo("us")` 或 `inferenceGeo("eu")` 进行数据驻留路由。属性为 `spring.ai.anthropic.chat.inference-geo`。

items.source: McpAsyncClientCustomizer and McpSyncClientCustomizer have been removed and replaced by a single generic interface McpClientCustomizer<B>.
items.translation: `McpAsyncClientCustomizer` 和 `McpSyncClientCustomizer` 已被移除，并由一个通用的接口 `McpClientCustomizer<B>` 替代。

items.source: McpSyncClientConfigurer and McpAsyncClientConfigurer constructors now accept List<McpClientCustomizer<…​>> instead of the old type-specific lists.
items.translation: `McpSyncClientConfigurer` 和 `McpAsyncClientConfigurer` 的构造函数现在接受 `<List<McpClientCustomizer<…>>>`，而非旧有的特定类型列表。

items.source: Key Point: The conversation history is used by the LLM to understand context and formulate responses, not by the tools themselves. Tools receive only their input parameters and any custom context you explicitly provide.
items.translation: 关键点： 对话历史由 大语言模型（LLM） 用于理解上下文并生成回复，而 工具 本身并不使用对话历史。工具仅接收其输入参数以及您明确提供的任何自定义上下文。

items.source: All internalCall and internalStream methods in model classes have been changed to private.
items.translation: 模型类中的所有 `internalCall` 和 `internalStream` 方法已更改为 `private`。

items.translation: OpenSearch Java 客户端：2.23.0 → 3.6.0

items.source: By default, if a model provider (e.g., OpenAI, Ollama) is found on the classpath, its corresponding auto-configuration for relevant model types (chat, embedding, etc.) is enabled. If multiple providers for the same model type are present (e.g., both spring-ai-openai-spring-boot-starter and spring-ai-ollama-spring-boot-starter), you can use the following properties to select which provider’s auto-configuration should be active, effectively disabling the others for that specific model type.

items.source: Each ChatModel instance, at construction time, accepts an optional ChatOptions or FunctionCallingOptions instance that can be used to configure default tools used for calling the model.
items.translation: 每个 `ChatModel` 实例在构造时，可接受一个可选的 `ChatOptions` 或 `FunctionCallingOptions` 实例，该实例可用于配置调用模型时使用的默认工具。

items.source: any tool passed via the functions() method of the default FunctionCallingOptions instance was included in each call to the model from that ChatModel instance, possibly overwritten by runtime options.
items.translation: 通过默认 `FunctionCallingOptions` 实例的 `functions()` 方法传递的任何工具，都会被包含在该 `ChatModel` 实例对模型的每次调用中，但可能会被运行时选项覆盖。

items.source: any tool passed via the functionCallbacks() method of the default FunctionCallingOptions instance was only made available for runtime dynamic resolution (see Tool Resolution), but never included in any call to the model unless explicitly requested.
items.translation: 通过默认 `FunctionCallingOptions` 实例的 `functionCallbacks()` 方法传递的任何工具，仅可用于运行时动态解析（参见 工具解析），除非显式请求，否则永远不会包含在调用模型的请求中。

items.source: In version 1.0.0-M6, the delete method in the VectorStore interface has been modified to be a void operation instead of returning an Optional<Boolean>. If your code previously checked the return value of the delete operation, you’ll need to remove this check. The operation now throws an exception if the deletion fails, providing more direct error handling.
items.translation: 在 1.0.0-M6 版本中，VectorStore 接口中的 delete 方法已被修改为 void 操作，不再返回 Optional<Boolean>。 如果您之前的代码检查了删除操作的返回值，则需要移除该检查。 现在，如果删除失败，该操作将抛出异常，从而提供更直接的错误处理机制。

items.source: The default value of the initialize-schema property on vector stores capable of initializing a schema is now set to false. This implies that the applications now need to explicitly opt-in for schema initialization on supported vector stores, if the schema is expected to be created at application startup. Not all vector stores support this property. See the corresponding vector store documentation for more details. The following are the vector stores that currently don’t support the initialize-schema property.
items.translation: 对于能够初始化架构的向量存储，initialize-schema 属性的默认值现已设置为 false。 这意味着，如果期望在应用程序启动时创建架构，则现在需要应用程序显式启用受支持的向量存储上的架构初始化功能。 并非所有向量存储都支持此属性。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅相应的向量存储文档。 以下是当前不支持 initialize-schema 属性的向量存储列表。

items.translation: 新功能为文本转图像客户端。类名为OpenAiImageModel和StabilityAiImageModel。请查看集成测试以了解用法，文档即将发布。

items.source: The spring-ai-advisors-vector-store module has been renamed to spring-ai-vector-store-advisor to better align with the naming conventions of other Spring AI modules.
items.translation: spring-ai-advisors-vector-store 模块已重命名为 spring-ai-vector-store-advisor，以更符合其他 Spring AI 模块的命名规范。

items.source: The ToolCallingAdvisor now manages conversation history internally across tool-call iterations by default. The memory advisor only stores the final user/assistant exchange, never writing tool-call messages to the ChatMemoryRepository. This is the correct default because most repository implementations do not support those message types.
items.translation: ToolCallingAdvisor 现在默认在工具调用迭代过程中内部管理对话历史。记忆顾问仅存储最终的用户/助手交互，从不将工具调用消息写入 ChatMemoryRepository。这是正确的默认行为，因为大多数仓库实现并不支持这些消息类型。

items.translation: Spring Boot 用户可以提供一个 `ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker` Bean；它将被自动配置的 `ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder` 自动拾取：

items.translation: 任何在顾问构建器上调用 `.streamToolCallResponses(true)` 或 `.streamToolCallResponses(false)` 的代码都将无法编译。

items.source: Any application.properties or application.yml entry for the removed properties is silently ignored.
items.translation: 任何已移除属性的application.properties或application.yml条目均会被静默忽略。

items.source: ChatOptions#copy() and *Options#fromOptions(*Options) methods have been removed because options are now strictly immutable.
items.translation: `ChatOptions#copy()` 和 `*Options#fromOptions(*Options)` 方法已被移除，因为选项现在必须是严格不可变的。

items.translation: ChatModel#getDefaultOptions() 已被弃用，建议使用 ChatModel#getOptions()。

items.translation: spring.ai.ollama.chat.think-option 配置属性已重命名为 spring.ai.ollama.chat.think。

Please use the Spring AI Anthropic support instead, configuring it with the https://api.minimax.io/anthropic base URL and MiniMax models. Embeddings are no longer supported.
items.translation: Minimax 的专用支持已移除，建议改用由 Minimax 官方推荐的 Anthropic 支持。 请使用 Spring AI 的 Anthropic 支持，并将其配置为使用 https://api.minimax.io/anthropic 作为基础 URL，同时指定 MiniMax 模型。 不再支持嵌入功能。

items.source: ChatClient now always auto-registers a ToolCallingAdvisor in the advisor chain (unless explicitly disabled), so tool calls requested by the model are handled automatically regardless of whether tools were configured statically or injected by another advisor at runtime.
items.translation: ChatClient 现在始终会在顾问链中自动注册一个 ToolCallingAdvisor（除非显式禁用），因此无论工具是静态配置还是由其他顾问在运行时注入，模型请求的工具调用都能得到自动处理。

items.source: Custom advisors that own the tool-call lifecycle should implement ToolAdvisor to prevent a duplicate ToolCallingAdvisor from being added automatically.
items.translation: 拥有工具调用生命周期的自定义顾问应实现ToolAdvisor，以防止自动添加重复的ToolCallingAdvisor。

items.source: Custom memory advisors that do not extend BaseChatMemoryAdvisor but should integrate with the tool-call auto-registration logic should implement MemoryAdvisor.
items.translation: 自定义内存顾问若未继承BaseChatMemoryAdvisor但需与工具调用自动注册逻辑集成，则应实现MemoryAdvisor接口。

items.source: Declare a ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder<?> bean to fully replace the auto-configured builder (suppressed via @ConditionalOnMissingBean).
items.translation: 声明一个 `ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder<?>` 类型的 Bean，以完全替换自动配置的构建器（该配置通过 `@ConditionalOnMissingBean` 被抑制）。

items.source: Alternatively, use @Tool-annotated methods for the declarative approach (see Tools API).
items.translation: 或者，使用带有@Tool注解的方法来实现声明式方法（参见工具 API）。

items.source: The spring-ai-spring-cloud-bindings module that provided integration for github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-bindings has been removed.
items.translation: 提供与github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-bindings集成的spring-ai-spring-cloud-bindings模块已被移除。

items.source: BeanOutputConverter now delegates JSON Schema generation to JsonSchemaGenerator, aligning structured output conversion with the JSON Schema behavior used for tool calling.
items.translation: `BeanOutputConverter` 现已将 JSON Schema 生成功能委托给 `JsonSchemaGenerator`，使结构化输出转换与工具调用中使用的 JSON Schema 行为保持一致。

items.source: To customize JSON Schema generation, override BeanOutputConverter.generateSchema() instead. Subclasses can post-process the default schema by delegating to super.generateSchema().
items.translation: 若要自定义 JSON Schema 的生成，请重写BeanOutputConverter.generateSchema()。子类可以通过委托给super.generateSchema()来对默认生成的 Schema 进行后处理。

items.translation: spring-ai-hanadb-store 模块已从 Spring AI 中移除。

items.source: Spring AI now uses the official openai-java SDK under the hood for all OpenAI models (Chat, Embeddings, Image, Audio Speech, Audio Transcription, and Moderation) in the spring-ai-openai module.
items.translation: Spring AI 现在在 spring-ai-openai 模块中，为所有 OpenAI 模型（包括 Chat、Embeddings、Image、Audio Speech、Audio Transcription 和 Moderation）底层使用官方的 openai-java SDK。

items.source: Existing users should use the spring-ai-openai module (and related starter and auto-configuration) instead and adapt class names (by removing the Azure prefix for example) and configuration properties accordingly.
items.translation: 现有用户应改用 `spring-ai-openai` 模块（及相关启动器和自动配置），并相应地调整类名（例如移除 `Azure` 前缀）和配置属性。

items.source: Existing users should use the spring-ai-openai module (and related starter and auto-configuration) instead and adapt class names accordingly (by removing the Sdk suffix for example) and configuration properties accordingly.
items.translation: 现有用户应改用 `<code>spring-ai-openai`》模块（及相关启动器和自动配置），并相应地调整类名（例如移除 `<code>Sdk` 后缀）以及配置属性。

items.source: Spring AI 2.0.0 upgrades the MCP Java SDK from 1.1.x to 2.0.0. This release introduces several breaking changes at the SDK level that may affect applications that interact with MCP types directly.
items.translation: Spring AI 2.0.0 将 MCP Java SDK 从1.1.x升级至2.0.0。此版本在 SDK 层面引入了多项破坏性变更，可能会影响直接与 MCP 类型交互的应用程序。

items.source: MCP servers now validate incoming tool arguments against the tool’s JSON schema before invoking the tool handler. Failed validation produces a CallToolResult with isError=true and a descriptive error message.
items.translation:
MCP 服务器现在会在调用工具处理器之前，根据工具的 JSON Schema 验证传入的工具参数。  
验证失败将返回一个 `CallToolResult`，其中 `isError=true`，并附带描述性错误信息。

items.source: Code that uses tool.inputSchema() as a JsonSchema object will fail to compile.
items.translation: 使用 `tool.inputSchema()` 作为 `JsonSchema` 对象的代码将无法编译。

items.source: Exhaustive switch expressions over these types that relied on the sealed hierarchy for completeness no longer compile without a default branch.
items.translation: 针对这些依赖密封层次结构以确保完整性的类型，现在必须包含default分支才能编译通过，否则 exhaustive（穷尽）的switch表达式将无法编译。

items.source: This upgrade was necessary for compatibility with Spring Boot 4.1.x, which uses HttpClient5 (org.apache.httpcomponents.client5:httpclient5) version 5.6. This version of HttpClient has a gzip content formatter breaking change that required the OpenSearch Java Client upgrade. See OpenSearch Java PR #1851 for details.
items.translation: 此次升级是为了与 Spring Boot 4.1.x 的兼容性而进行的，该版本使用了 HttpClient5（org.apache.httpcomponents.client5:httpclient5）5.6 版本。此版本的 HttpClient 引入了 gzip 内容格式化器的破坏性变更，因此需要升级 OpenSearch Java Client。有关详细信息，请参阅 OpenSearch Java PR #1851。

items.source: JSON-based filters (e.g. PostgreSQL JSONPath, Neo4j Cypher, Weaviate): use emitJsonValue(Object value, StringBuilder context) to serialize values with proper quoting and escaping.
items.translation: 基于 JSON 的过滤器（例如 PostgreSQL JSONPath、Neo4j Cypher、Weaviate）：使用 emitJsonValue(Object value, StringBuilder context) 来对值进行序列化，并添加正确的引号和转义。

items.source: Lucene-based filters (e.g. Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, GemFire): use emitLuceneString(String value, StringBuilder context) for string values, and handle other types (numbers, booleans, dates) according to your store’s query syntax.
items.translation: 基于 Lucene 的过滤器（例如 Elasticsearch、OpenSearch、GemFire）：对字符串值使用 emitLuceneString(String value, StringBuilder context)，并根据存储库的查询语法处理其他类型（数字、布尔值、日期）。

items.source:
The Spring AI autoconfiguration has changed from a single monolithic artifact to individual autoconfiguration artifacts per model, vector store, and other components.
This change was made to minimize the impact of different versions of dependent libraries conflicting, such as Google Protocol Buffers, Google RPC, and others.
By separating autoconfiguration into component-specific artifacts, you can avoid pulling in unnecessary dependencies and reduce the risk of version conflicts in your application.
items.translation:

此项变更旨在最小化依赖库不同版本之间的冲突影响，例如 Google Protocol Buffers、Google RPC 等。  
通过将自动配置分离为特定组件的构件，您可以避免引入不必要的依赖项，并降低应用程序中版本冲突的风险。

items.source: This restriction applies to ChatClient only. When calling ChatModel.call(Prompt) directly, the prompt must carry a fully built ChatOptions instance of the concrete type expected by the model (e.g. AnthropicChatOptions for AnthropicChatModel). The ChatModel does not merge options: if Prompt.getOptions() is non-null it is used as-is; if it is null, the model’s own default options are used instead. No partial merging occurs at the ChatModel level.
items.translation: 此限制仅适用于 ChatClient。当直接调用 ChatModel.call(Prompt) 时，提示词必须携带一个完全构建好的、符合模型预期具体类型的 ChatOptions 实例（例如，对于 AnthropicChatModel 需使用 AnthropicChatOptions）。ChatModel 不会合并选项：如果 Prompt.getOptions() 不为 null，则直接使用该选项；如果为 null，则改用模型自身的默认选项。在 ChatModel 层面不会发生部分合并。

items.source: The framework normalizes values (e.g. ISO date strings converted to Date) before invoking doSingleValue, so your implementation receives already-normalized values.
